visible_goal: Analyze a straight rectangular solid bar under tensile surface traction; report free-end displacement and axial stress.
selection_reason: Simple 3D solid statics is directly supported by both FEA tools.

metric_definitions.free_end_displacement: Final global U1 in mm at the unique undeformed node (100, 5, 5).
metric_definitions.axial_stress: -sum(final global RF1 over all X=0 fixed-face nodes) / 100 mm^2, reported as positive tensile MPa.

bounds_semantics: open intervals used only as broad physical sanity filters; native-result agreement and the task contract determine acceptance
